notes.title: Desta: The Memories Between Is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's Launch Day and [i][b]Desta: The Memories Between (Dream Team Edition)[/b] [/i] is available right now to play. Fall into Desta's dreams and experience a roguelite tactics journey designed the only way ustwo games can!

With every purchase of Dream Team Edition, you will receive a lovely Digital Art Book and Complete Game Soundtrack from UK Artist Mansur Brown all available for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2009650/

We would LOVE to hear what you think of Desta as you play our game, so please join our ustwo games discord and chat with other players in community as well as developers. Throughout the launch week, we will be around to answer questions, with plans for AMA's, livestreams and more content coming up soon!

Join the discord: [b][url=https://go.ustwo.games/discord]https://go.ustwo.games/discord[/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506701/80dba543e4589e2ee69bc457db4c79ca1d6f6724.png[/img]

[h3]WHAT IS DESTA: THE MEMORIES BETWEEN?[/h3]
From the creators of Monument Valley (that's us)!, Desta: The Memories Between is our latest genre-bending title. A heartfelt strategy game where you fall into a mysterious dreamworld. Grab your emotionally-charged ball, track your opponent's strategy and work tactically with your ultimate dream-team to throw the best shot and get to the heart of the conversation. 

Desta: The Memories Between combines ustwo games’ approach to character storytelling with distinctive team-based tactics and physics gameplay, featuring strategic chess-like play with perfect physics precision!

[h3]WHAT IS ‘DREAM TEAM EDITION’?[/h3]
Dream Team Edition is the digital collector’s edition of our cosy tactics game - compiling all major content updates together, including all characters, new game modes (including Challenge Mode and Nightmare Mode - which both unlock after the completion of the main story), as well a complete game soundtrack composed by acclaimed UK Artist Mansur Brown and a beautiful Digital Art Book! This is the ultimate bundle for fans of ustwo games!

[h3]WHAT IS THE GAME STRUCTURE?[/h3]
When first playing Desta: The Memories Between, you will have access to the Main Story, which can be played in a linear fashion to completion from the very beginning. As Desta is a roguelike, there is an expectation that you may fail at times, and will have to start again - carrying over all your upgraded abilities. 

As you progress through the game, there are options on Rest Floors with Crystal Desta where you may be able to ‘skip ahead’ to the latest chapter. This is the best solution for those invested in the story. For those invested in the skill and tactical challenge, then playing the game in the more traditional roguelike route may be the best option. As developers interested in making approachable games, we wanted to provide an option for every type of tactics and roguelike player. 

At ustwo games, we are huge believers in approachability and accessibility in games, so we have worked hard to create an extensive amount of accessibility gaming options for all types of players too. 

[b][url=https://www.taminggaming.com/en-gb/accessibility/Desta+The+Memories+Between]Our friends over at the Family Gaming Database have produced a full Accessibility Report for Desta, which you can read here[/url][/b]

[h3]WHAT ARE CHALLENGE MODE + NIGHTMARE MODE (POST-GAME CONTENT)? [/h3]
[b]Challenge Mode[/b] provides brand new standalone scenarios designed to test the most experienced of players in unique ways. Complete these challenges to unlock bonus team mates for Desta's main dream, as well as aid you as you dive deeper into Nightmare Mode.

[b]Nightmare Mode[/b] provides the most tactical challenge yet - providing encounters to face and modified rules. Any HP lost in a previous memory carries over to the next encounter, so you will need to be careful to see if you can reach the end of the Nightmare.

[h3]WITH EVERY PURCHASE OF DESTA, SUPPORT YOUNG PEOPLE IN NEED[/h3]
Following our campaign with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1337010/Alba_A_Wildlife_Adventure/]Alba: A Wildlife Adventure[/url] and seeing how much you loved us planting over 1 million trees for every download of the game, we knew we wanted to do something similar with Desta. We have partnered up with nationwide charity UK Youth to donate 3% of profits to youth centres and youth work to keep inspiring young people to live up to their potential with creative, safe spaces during this tough cost-of-living crisis. Find out more here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2009650/view/3681172219983553896?l=english

From your friends,

ustwo games

notes.title: Dream Team Edition is COMING SOON! Add to Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to the first of many upcoming developer blogs from us - we hope you like hearing more about the making of [i][b]Desta[/b][/i] and we would love to hear from you too!

First off, the big news: [i][b]Desta: The Memories Between (Dream Team Edition)[/b][/i] will RELEASE in a few short months on 26 April 2023!

We always wanted [i][b]Desta: The Memories Between[/b][/i] to have the widest possible audience following its debut on mobile last year, so we’re delighted to share that a new, expanded and enhanced Dream Team Edition will be available for everyone to play!

Our[b] Dream Team Edition[/b] is the ultimate collector’s edition and we hope you love it. It compiles major content updates together, including all characters (with new ones yet to be revealed), new game modes (including Challenge Mode and Nightmare Mode), as well a complete game soundtrack composed by acclaimed UK Artist Mansur Brown and a beautiful Digital Art Book! This is the ultimate bundle for fans of Desta and ustwo games!

Dream Team Edition also offers more flexibility for every type of player, featuring:
[list]
[*] [b]Shortcuts[/b] for story-focused gamers, 
[*] [b]Challenge Mode[/b] for players wanting to take their tactics to the next level with a variety of surprising and unique challenges to overcome outside of the core game experience, and
[*] [b]Nightmare Mode[/b], a first for ustwo games, is an ultra hardcore gameplay experience for those wanting to fully immerse themselves in the roguelike aspects of memories between. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506701/755816e2f69bd89b5f34c5203256598f5aef2698.gif[/img]

[h2]12 Weeks of Desta[/h2]

To celebrate Desta’s Steam debut we’ll be giving players tons of exclusive insights between now and release. These ‘12(ish)Weeks of Desta’ will include sneak peeks from the development team, deep dives into the new Dream Team game modes and tutorials on the control system, which has been reimagined for gaming on PC.

We’ll also be revealing the brand new artwork, audio and gameplay that PC players will experience as they fall into Desta’s dreamscapes

[h2]Sign up for the beta[/h2]

In many ways Desta is a game about community – so of course we’d love feedback from you, our player community. That’s why we’ll be inviting everyone to get involved with the Dream Team Edition closed beta in March – we’ll be posting more details to the Desta channel on our ustwo games Discord!

In fact, we would love for you to share your thoughts with us any time you like via our Discord and social media. And those channels will also keep you fully up-to-date on all things Desta: 

[b]Discord[/b]: https://go.ustwo.games/discord
[b]Twitter[/b]: @ustwogames
[b]Instagram[/b]: instagram.com/ustwogames/
[b]Facebook[/b]: https://www.facebook.com/ustwogames/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506701/eeb3596f7f5af91d4107a43822380bf092dc8561.png[/img]

We can’t wait to welcome you into Desta’s dream world over the coming weeks and months - don’t forget to add us to your Wish List right now! https://go.ustwo.games/dreamteam

Your friends,

ustwo games
